description: This file provides utility functions to split a string into substrings based on spaces, using a custom LinkedList implementation to store the tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens separated by spaces and stores them in a LinkedList.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it is not empty.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is non-empty.
